title: considering speed of glucose changing and compare to blood glucose level
symptom: The user reports that Libre 2 sensor readings are delayed compared to blood glucose readings, especially when glucose is changing rapidly, and asks if xDrip+ accounts for this delay.
cause: The thread discusses that Libre 2 values are delayed because they come from interstitial fluid, which lags behind blood glucose. The maintainer explains that this delay is inherent to all CGMs and varies per person and situation.
fix: No fix was implemented. The maintainer suggests calibrating only when the trend is flat and closes the issue without merging the proposed equation.
evidence_quote: The libre 2 raw values are wrong, because they are always delayed. Thes come from interstitial fluid and are not equal to the blood sugar concentration. With my equation this deficiency can be solved.
